infer_device_type: infer the device type from a pandas DataFrame of GPU or CPU trace events
create_grouping_pattern: create a GroupingPattern dataclass with a regex pattern, inverse match flag, and group name
match_grouping_pattern: match a kernel or event name string against a GroupingPattern to classify trace events
convert_to_grouping_pattern: convert a string, list of strings, or compiled regex into a GroupingPattern object
use_common_grouping_patterns: use the common_grouping_patterns dictionary to filter memory, compute, or communicate kernels from trace data
